title: Why Your Phone Always Hits Your Nose in Bed
caption:
The phone you scroll with in bed is a nose missile
A cartoon lies on its back scrolling, the phone slips and smacks straight onto its nose, then a split-screen physics board shows gravity, acceleration and impact arrows all converging as point pressure.
All the energy the phone picked up while falling gets concentrated onto the tiny contact area of your nose tip, and since pressure is force divided by area, a small spot means a huge spike, which is why a light phone can hurt that much.
Have you ever dropped your phone on your own face mid-scroll, and where did it land?
Save this and lie on your side tonight.
